title: WaterColor 64 Vermilion Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 14 wristbands.- Private Pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $35 per day.*- Carriage house- Nonsmoking property (inside and out)- 6 adult bikes- Parking for up to 5 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: This incredible 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath home plus 1-bed and 1-bath carriage house, in the Lake District of WaterColor, is sure to delight. With its massive rooms and exquisite furnishings, this will be your perfect vacation retreat. When entering the home, you will be welcomed by the magnificent great room, with its ten-foot ceilings, rich flooring, and stunning furnishings. You will also be able to enjoy meals from the fantastic kitchen. There, you will experience the high-end appliances, granite countertops, stunning cabinetry, and the gigantic island. This kitchen has all of the items needed to prepare that fabulous meal! The massive living room, well-appointed dining room, and remarkable kitchen are comprised of an open floor plan for everyone to enjoy after a fun-filled day at the beach. What a perfect end to a perfect day! On the first floor, you will encounter a stately bedroom with warm-toned furnishings and a king-size bed. It comes complete with a connecting bathroom with a single vanity and a walk-in shower. On the second floor, you will find the boundless primary king bedroom with comfortable furnishings and its own balcony access. It has an amazing connecting primary bath with double vanity and a tub, and a separate shower. This will definitely give you that vacation retreat you were looking for! There is another spacious king-size bedroom with a neutral pallet on this floor with a connecting bathroom featuring a single vanity and a walk-in shower. There is a lovely king bedroom with a connecting bathroom with a single vanity and a walk-in shower. Additionally, there is a second sitting room with TV and sofa sleeper. Lastly, on the third floor, there is a bedroom that has two extra-large bunk beds, which is perfect for the kids! There is also a connecting bathroom with double vanity and a walk-in shower on this floor. This home has a half bathroom on the first and second floor. The marvelous Carriage House offers a king bed and sofa sleeper with a studio feel and all of the comforts you would expect. This home provides parking for 5 vehicles. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Bunk Room: Two Twin Built-in Bunk Beds (4), Shared Bathroom with Shower Only CARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Sleeper (4), Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to fines.As of June 2022, there is construction in the vicinity of this home.
